description: Playwright suite: browser or component tests run by file through the project's own playwright. Tests are discovered by filename glob, either as siblings under the area's own paths or under a central root whose filename stem matches a changed source file; the whole suite runs as the playwright config defines it.

project_dir.description: $PROJ-relative directory holding package.json and node_modules, for repos whose app lives below the repo root. The runner resolves its binary and runs from here. Defaults to ".".

config.description: The playwright config file, relative to project_dir, passed as --config. Empty by default, so playwright finds its own.

root.description: Directory under which the "filename" strategy looks for centralized tests. Defaults to "tests".

glob.description: Filename glob(s) identifying this suite's test files: a single pattern or an array of patterns whose matches are unioned. Defaults to "*.spec.ts"; a component suite names "*.ct.jsx" or "*.ct.tsx".

exclude.description: Filename glob(s) to drop from the matched test files: a single pattern or an array of patterns.
